titulo.en: I will have finished, I would have gone

intro.en: Two compound tenses: the future perfect and the conditional perfect.

habría.en: I would have, he/she would have (auxiliary)

habrá pasado.en: can have happened, will have happened

texto.en:
The **future perfect** is **habré, habrás, habrá, habremos, habréis, habrán** + participle. It is something finished before a point in the future.

- **Para el viernes habré terminado.**
- Dentro de un año **nos habremos mudado**.

It is also a guess about the recent past, just as the simple future is a guess about now.

- No contesta. **Habrá salido.** (he must have gone out)

The **conditional perfect** is **habría, habrías, habría, habríamos, habríais, habrían** + participle. It is what would have happened, and did not.

- Yo **habría ido**, pero no pude.
- En tu lugar, yo no **habría dicho** nada.

A reproach uses it too: ¡me lo **habrías podido** decir!

frases.en: When do you finish the project?

frases.es: Para el viernes lo habré terminado.
frases.en: By Friday I'll have finished it.

frases.es: Marta no ha venido hoy. ¿Qué habrá pasado?
frases.en: Marta hasn't come today. What can have happened?

frases.es: Habrá perdido el tren. Ayer tampoco llegó a tiempo.
frases.en: She must have missed the train. She didn't arrive on time yesterday either.

frases.es: Yo en su lugar habría avisado.
frases.en: In her place I would have let people know.

frases.es: Tienes razón. Yo también habría llamado.
frases.en: You're right. I would have called too.

pregunta.en: Complete: by Monday I will have finished.

habré.en: Finished before a future point: future perfect.

habría.en: Habría terminado is would have finished.

he.en: He terminado is already finished now.

pregunta.en: He isn't answering. Guess: he must have gone out.

Habrá.en: The future perfect is a guess about the recent past.

Habría.en: Habría salido is a guess about an earlier past, or would have.

Haya.en: Haya needs a trigger for the subjunctive.

pregunta.en: Complete: in your place, I would have gone.

habría.en: What would have happened: conditional perfect.

habré.en: Habré ido is will have gone.

había.en: Había ido says it really happened.

She has probably missed the train.en: A guess about what has happened.

She would have missed the train.en: That is habría perdido el tren.

traduccion.en: By Friday I will have finished it.

texto.en:
**The app cannot check this part.** For the writing, please use pen and paper. For the speaking, say it out loud and, if you can, practise with a native speaker or a teacher who can correct you.

**Write (150–180 words).** Write what you will have achieved in five years' time, and what you would have done differently in the last five.

**Speak (about 3 minutes).** Speculate aloud about why a friend has not answered your messages: Habrá perdido…, se le habrá…
